text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thank you for coming
to Oi Racecourse today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Things might still be tough right now,
but let's hype things up!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The umadol, Smart Falcon, has descended upon the Teio Sho. What is more—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Falco-o!
You're the absolute strongest!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Show us that invincible runaway lead
that stunned the entire regional circuit again today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me!! Especially at a time like this,
I'm defiiinitely not giving up position zero♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Touring through regional racetracks with victory after victory.
Forging an unfathomable strength along the way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And it wasn't just Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Falco, I'm not gonna let you strut around actir' all high and mighty!
I'm totally gonna make you cry!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...A race nearby where local fans have come to watch.
—I cannot lose."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Espoir City and Furioso also entering,
it became a true dream race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now, Transcend is counted among
their ranks as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: Pull yourself together, Tran! Let's stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Right you are, Trainy.
Thanks for firing me up. Gotta do this."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"You don't often see a lineup like this assembled.
And so..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: With today, all the data for Cinema Gun will be gathered.
choice_data_list: Yeah, leave the photography to me.
Yeah, leave the filming to me.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. We've come this far aiming for 100% completion, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(I have a lot of thoughts on this.
But... right now...!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Time to get my head back in the game.
Alright—let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you on the racetrack, Tran-san♪
Let's have a great race today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With the most spectacular race and show,
let's bring joy to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Falco-chan, you're...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh, I wonder what it is, I wonder what it is?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: No, it's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Why can you...
smile like that?)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: (Why can you... still believe in what lies beyond the finish line without wavering?)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(...I wonder if I can go back.
Once this race is over, maybe I...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Right, I'm just a little shaken up.
It might just be a passing whim...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "If I can pull off a heartfelt run here... once more!"
